tasks.short: Tailor conservation plans to landowner goals

steps.what: Discuss the landowner's actual livestock, wildlife or recreation goals and practical constraints
outputs: Actual goal discussion and clarified constraints

steps.what: Read existing site surveys and the current conservation plan using native property and document-version filters
inputs: Existing site surveys and plan produced by conservation staff
outputs: Verified site evidence and plan version in the existing geographic information system

steps.what: Tailor actual conservation measures and priorities to the landowner's goals, site evidence and ecological limits
inputs: Original site evidence and existing plan

steps.what: Write and check the tailored conservation plan using native reuse of exact property references and unchanged plan fields
Save the tailored plan in its existing document workspace

tasks.design: Use property and version filters in the existing geographic information system, {OTHER}, and reuse exact references in {DOCS}. The manager discusses actual goals, selects ecological measures and writes the tailored plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Property references and unchanged plan fields are repeatedly found and copied.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filters and linked fields can reduce that repeated handling while preserving actual plan judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Landowner preferences can conflict with ecological capacity or each other.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate a practical conservation approach suited to this landowner and site.

ambition.what: No additional planning or land-treatment capacity is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect property and plan access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native property filters and exact plan-field reuse can reduce repeated handling while conservation choices and landowner discussions remain human.

assumptions: Representative plan-tailoring episode using existing site evidence, not a claim that fresh site investigation is unnecessary. Conservation staff produce existing surveys and plans during ordinary work; focal reading and verification are counted in s2. If fresh investigation is needed, add its actual field and recording work before estimating that episode.
s1 supplies actual goals through human discussion; s3 counts their interpretation and actual measure choices. No transcript, clean goal feed or automatic plan decision is assumed.

s4 separately includes actual plan writing and full checking. Only unchanged fields and exact property references are reused from sources verified in s2. Native functionality comes first; existing reuse yields no new gain.

The task ends with a tailored working plan. Actual landowner issue, formal agreement, funding commitment or implementation needs its own real work and authority if included. Ordinary same-system save is ungated, not an author self-approval and carries no saving.

Provisional shares ignore prompt priors. Gross 20*0.10+24*0.20=6.8; upkeep 2 leaves net 4.8. Retained discussion, source reading, plan decisions and writing total 92.2 already counted. Save share 1 is the schema minimum for negligible effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Whether plan fields already reuse property references
Actual need for fresh site investigation
research_questions: Observe one actual conservation-plan revision and separate landowner discussion from written plan changes.

already_counted.description: Goal discussion, evidence reading, measure choices and actual plan writing remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain property filters and plan links beyond ordinary plan checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires both repeated property navigation and repeated exact plan fields. If existing native plan tools already remove both, no additional saving or new configuration upkeep is incurred. Actual discussion and conservation decisions remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study grazing patterns and determine sustainable grazing choices

steps.what: Observe actual forage conditions and grazing patterns; capture field measurements, dates and site notes
inputs: Actual range conditions and investigation question

steps.what: Read actual livestock, forage, season and cost records; verify and enter field values and specify comparison formulas and assumptions
inputs: Existing livestock and cost records produced by land managers
outputs: Checked entered inputs with units, periods and explicit formulas

steps.what: Calculate explicitly specified forage-use, animal-day and cost comparisons across actual grazing scenarios
inputs: Entered inputs and formulas from s2
outputs: Scenario comparison values with missing inputs flagged

steps.what: Study grazing patterns against original evidence and calculation results; determine appropriate livestock numbers, kinds and grazing seasons
Write and check the actual working grazing-study finding and its supporting references
Save the study finding in its existing workspace

tasks.design: Capture actual grazing and forage evidence, then use explicitly specified formulas in {SPREADSHEET} to compare scenarios. The manager checks originals, chooses appropriate grazing numbers and seasons, and records the study finding in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated forage-use and cost comparisons are calculated manually across scenarios.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can repeat explicit arithmetic on entered measurements and actual assumptions.
tasks.still_hard: Forage variability, animal needs, ecological limits and uncertain costs affect any profitable grazing choice.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret local conditions and avoid treating calculated scenarios as observed carrying capacity.

ambition.what: Compare another defensible grazing season using actual available evidence.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual grazing and cost record access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit spreadsheet calculations can repeat grazing and cost comparisons while observation, assumptions and actual grazing choices remain human.

assumptions: Representative grazing-study episode with actual field observation and working findings. Land managers produce existing livestock and cost records during ordinary work. All focal field capture, record verification, input entry and formula specification are counted in s1-s2; no digital sensor feed is assumed.

s2 produces every input, unit, period and formula used by s3. Missing or incompatible data stop the affected scenario and require actual manual investigation. No livestock requirements, prices or ecological thresholds are invented by the calculation.
Native formulas come first. Existing formula execution is today's baseline and yields no new gain. s4 includes calculation checking against originals and scientific interpretation, fully retained.

s5 is an actual study finding, separate from field observation. There is no invented post-visit report, automatic livestock movement, purchase, landowner notice or grazing authorisation. Any real implementation requires distinct actual work and authority before extending this estimate.

Shares are provisional independent of the prior. Gross 20; incremental upkeep 3 leaves net 17. Retained s1,s2,s4,s5 labour is 79 already counted. Minimum integer save share 1 is fully retained and represents negligible same-system effort; no self-approval or saving.
unknowns: Which grazing comparisons are already automated
Actual data quality and seasonal variability
research_questions: Inspect one real grazing study and identify manual repeated calculations separately from fieldwork and judgement.

already_counted.description: Field capture, source and formula preparation, scientific checking and finding writing remain in s1,s2,s4,s5.

incremental.description: Maintain scenario formulas beyond ordinary grazing-study checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires 20 points of observed repeated manual arithmetic. If native formulas already handle 12 of those points, eligible gross is 8; 3 upkeep leaves 5. Fully automated existing calculations require a lower re-estimate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain soil and vegetation for non-grazing uses

steps.what: Inspect actual soil stability and vegetation at the wildlife or recreation site; capture condition notes
inputs: Actual site and intended non-grazing use

steps.what: Choose the actual maintenance measures and confirm immediate site, equipment and work readiness before physical maintenance
inputs: Existing legitimate maintenance authority and equipment
outputs: Actual current decision to proceed with specified physical maintenance

steps.what: Perform the actual soil-stability and vegetation maintenance for wildlife habitat or outdoor recreation
outputs: Actual physical maintenance and observed outcome

steps.what: Write and check the actual maintenance entry from completed work, using native reuse of the existing site identifier
inputs: Actual completed work and observed outcome
Existing site identifier in the land-maintenance register

steps.what: Save the completed entry in the existing land-maintenance register

tasks.design: Keep actual site assessment and physical soil and vegetation maintenance with the manager. The existing land-maintenance register, {OPS_SYSTEM}, can reuse a site identifier when the manager writes the actual post-work entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: The site identifier is repeatedly entered into a real maintenance record.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record context can reuse that exact identifier.
tasks.still_hard: Physical work, ecological assessment and immediate work readiness remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt maintenance to actual ground conditions and habitat or recreation needs.

ambition.what: No material expansion of physical maintenance capacity is assumed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native site-context field can reduce repeated identifier entry; it does not perform soil or vegetation maintenance.

assumptions: Representative episode where the range manager actually performs physical maintenance and an actual required register entry. If crews do the physical work, measure the manager's different supervision episode rather than attributing crew labour to this estimate.

s1 counts actual condition capture; s2 counts actual immediate work choice and readiness, not author approval of paperwork. a1 is the existing physical action readiness decision for s3, and changes in conditions invalidate it. No new self-approval of a written record is introduced.

Existing site identifiers are produced when the maintenance register is established by land-management staff; the manager verifies the actual site while inspecting it in s1. Missing or incorrect identifiers are resolved manually, not supplied by a free clean feed.

s4 separately counts the real post-work record and all checking. Only exact site-identifier entry is reduced. Use native context first; if already available it yields no additional saving. Do not invent a maintenance report or completion record where none exists.
The entry describes work actually completed, never planned work as done. The ordinary save is ungated, negligible active effort represented by schema minimum share 1, fully retained with no saving.
Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 9*0.10=0.9; incremental upkeep 0.3 gives net 0.6. Retained s1-s4 labour is 98.1 already counted.
unknowns: Whether a real maintenance entry and native site context exist
research_questions: Observe one actual non-grazing maintenance episode and inspect any required post-work entry.

already_counted.description: Actual site inspection, work readiness, physical maintenance and post-work entry remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain site-context reuse beyond ordinary entry checking.

approvals.approved_version: Specified physical maintenance under the actual current site and equipment conditions; any change requires a fresh readiness decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound removes only repeated site-identifier entry from the actual post-work record. Existing native context or absence of a required entry leaves no additional gain or new configuration upkeep. Physical work remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage forage treatment for sustainable range yield

steps.what: Read the actual forage treatment history and land-management plan using native site and treatment-date filters
inputs: Existing actual treatment records and land-management plan
outputs: Verified site and treatment context in the geographic information system

steps.what: Inspect actual forage and vegetation conditions and capture observations relevant to treatment management
inputs: Actual range conditions and verified history

steps.what: Manage forage resources by assessing the actual revegetation treatment against sustainable-yield goals and existing treatment authority
outputs: Human treatment-management judgement and unresolved issues

steps.what: Coordinate and monitor the actual on-site revegetation work with the treatment crew under the existing authorised plan
inputs: Real crew, site conditions and treatment progress
outputs: Actual crew coordination and observed treatment progress

steps.what: Write and check the actual treatment-management entry, reusing exact site references from the existing treatment record
inputs: Actual observed treatment progress and coordination
Verified existing site and treatment references
outputs: Completed treatment-management entry in the geographic information system

steps.what: Save the actual treatment-management entry in its existing workspace

tasks.design: Use native treatment-history filters in the geographic information system, {OTHER}, with the actual plan in {DOCS}. Retain field observation, treatment judgement and live crew coordination; reuse only exact references when writing the real treatment entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Managers repeatedly locate treatment history and copy site references into actual management records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geographic filters and reference reuse can reduce those clerical operations.
tasks.still_hard: Treatment choice, timing, ecological consequences and on-site coordination depend on actual conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Manage sustainable yield while recognising when the authorised plan no longer fits the site.

ambition.what: No automatic treatment or extra treated area is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual treatment records and crew workflow

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native treatment-record filters and reference reuse can assist forage management without choosing or performing a land treatment.

assumptions: Representative management episode for an already authorised revegetation treatment, one method named by the statement. It is not an estimate of fire, herbicide operations or every treatment mix. Those require their actual planning, permissions, physical actions, readiness and records before a separate estimate.

Crew and land-management staff produce existing treatment records in normal work; focal reading and actual observation remain in s1-s2. s5 reuses only exact verified references. Missing records require manual investigation; no clean vegetation feed or inferred treatment status is assumed.

Actual crew planting and equipment work remain unchanged and are not counted as focal saving. This episode counts manager coordination and observation in s4. If the manager personally performs physical treatment, add and retain that real labour rather than applying this episode unchanged.

Existing treatment authority is an actual entry condition, not a newly invented approval. s3 does not issue a new treatment order; a changed plan must stop and follow the real authorisation workflow. No hidden crew notice, purchase, burn, chemical release or planting commitment is automated.

s5 separately includes the actual management record after observed work; no completion is inferred from a planned treatment. Native functionality comes first and existing filters yield no new gain. Save share 1 is the schema minimum for negligible same-system effort, fully retained and ungated; no self-approval.
Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 15*0.20+9*0.10=3.9; upkeep 1 leaves net 2.9. Retained s1-s5 labour is 95.1 already counted.
unknowns: Actual treatment and management duty mix
Existing geographic record filters and required treatment entries
research_questions: Observe one authorised revegetation management episode and separate manager observation, crew labour and actual record entry.

already_counted.description: Treatment-history reading, actual inspection, treatment judgement, crew coordination and management entry remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain treatment-history filters and reference reuse beyond current record checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires repeated history navigation and site-reference copying. If existing geographic tools already perform both, no additional saving or configuration upkeep is incurred. No gain is claimed for field observation, treatment decisions or crew coordination.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Treatment crews performing actual land work
skills_to_grow: Reliable site and treatment record use
Separate actual completion records from treatment plans
role.ambitious_version: A range manager who uses evidence and records more efficiently while retaining landowner relationships, local ecological judgement and responsibility for real land work.
